resources.string: Try the app on test data, share it
TEST MODE · test data only, your real data is closed

Test mode opens a separate profile with sample data: wallets, transactions, budgets, bills, goals and portfolio. Your real data stays closed and cannot be seen or changed. Test data can be changed freely, saved to a file and sent to other people, for example developers working on BHODL.
No PIN needed. Leave test mode at any time.
You are in test mode. Everything you change stays in the test data.
The current test data and its initial state are replaced by the file’s. Export them first if you want to keep them.
Keep the file’s dates (otherwise they move to today)
The test data as it is now becomes the state “Back to initial state” returns to. The previous initial state is replaced.
Every change made since the initial state is lost. Export the test data first if you want to keep it.
The current test data and its initial state are replaced by the test data that comes with BHODL.
This file is not BHODL test data. Only test data can be imported.
The file cannot be read as BHODL test data.
This file was made by a newer BHODL. Update the app to open it.
The file is too large to be test data.
